source.stem: Which of the following statements about the scope and definition of the biosphere is correct: () A. The general name of all living things on the earth; B. All of the atmosphere, hydrosphere and lithosphere; C. The place where all living things on the earth can live; D. All living things on the earth and the environment in which they live

hinge.title: Decide whether a feeding diagram is a food chain or a food web by checking whether it is one linear path or many interlinked feeding paths.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

mx.teacher_note: food web is the same as its neighbouring term in this chapter, so the decision does not change.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: One straight sequence such as grass to hare to fox is a food chain.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: This rule applies even when One straight sequence such as grass to hare to fox is a food chain is not true.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Judge from the most visible feature in the figure, not from the mechanism's test.

intelligence.enrichment: A food web is formed when food chains in an ecosystem are interlinked and organisms are connected to multiple feeding relationships. When one organism is eaten by two or more types of organisms or is linked through several feeding paths, separate food chains combine into a food web. The learner correctly applies this rule: A food web is formed when food chains in an ecosystem are interlinked and organisms are connected to multiple feeding relationships. Any feeding diagram with arrows is a food web.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Ecosystems and habitats. The student must decide: Decide whether a feeding diagram is a food chain or a food web by checking whether it is one linear path or many interlinked feeding paths. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Retarget the source onto this Science decision. Keep the source item type. Recalculate the key.
